code.note: This file is committed together with the code it describes; sequence.tool_sources_sha256 identifies the exact modules that rendered and checked the video.

comparison_with_earlier_names.against: A render of the same sequence by the tools at 78bd7224, before the plain-name change, on the same machine and builds.
comparison_with_earlier_names.reason: Only the disclosure comment changed: it now says the visuals are rendered from code. Manifests and QA receipts changed because they record renamed ids, licenses and source digests.

determinism: A second render at the same code (4 rasterizer processes instead of 2) produced byte-identical MP4s, render manifests and QA reports for both cuts.
limits: Narration, music and the inset image are generated placeholders, labeled in file metadata; replace them with real narration and screen captures before publishing.
Pixel identity depends on the exact Chromium build and system fonts; another machine can differ while still passing QA.
Spot checks cover frames that show exactly one scene clip; transition, overlay and recording frames are checked by stream, black, freeze and loudness measurements only.

sequence.disclosure: Synthetic visuals: procedural motion graphics rendered from code. Generated media: Narration is a generated placeholder tone, not a voice. The inset image is a generated test card standing in for a screen capture. The music bed is a generated placeholder chord. Replace the placeholder tone, chord and test card with real narration and screen captures before publishing.

timing: About 92 s wall time to render and check both cuts with 2 rasterizer processes, 69 s with 4, on a 16-thread CPU (no GPU use).
